description: You are my son, today I have begotten you
Your throne, O God, is forever
They shall perish but you remain
What is man that you are mindful of him
You crowned him with glory and honor
You put all things under his feet
I will declare your name to my brothers
Today if you hear his voice
They shall not enter my rest
As I swore in my wrath
Sacrifice and offering you did not want
In burnt offerings you took no pleasure
Behold I come, in the volume of the book
Till his enemies be made a footstool (repeated)
